name: B10-0363/2026 (ECR) – The threat of war crimes, the escalating violations of international humanitarian law and the human rights situation in El-Obeid, Sudan
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the threat of war crimes, the escalating violations of international humanitarian law and the human rights situation in El-Obeid, Sudan
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its position on the war in Sudan, especially the city of El-Obeid, which it says is at risk of mass atrocities. It asks Sudan's two warring sides to stop attacks on civilians and let aid through. It asks the European Union to keep or widen sanctions on those responsible and to give more humanitarian aid. It also calls for peace talks and independent investigations.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. It is the Parliament's opinion and a set of requests, not a decision.
- **Who it affects:** Sudan's warring sides, people in El-Obeid, aid workers, and anyone under European Union sanctions.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to the Council, the Commission, Sudan's authorities, the African Union and the United Nations.
